title: Arthur and the world
caption: Before Earth, the animals lived on a small piece of land in the clouds.
notes: Before Earth and humans existed, animals lived on a small piece of land among the clouds. There was only empty space past its edges. Arthur, the god of the sky, lived above them. A flame inside his chest gave him the power to create things. Another god, Varek, wanted that power for himself.

title: Varek starts a fight
caption: Varek wanted Arthur’s power, but he couldn’t win the fight.
notes: One day, Varek challenged Arthur to a fight. They fought above the clouds, and thunder shook the animals’ trees below. Arthur was stronger. Every time Varek attacked, Arthur pushed him back. Varek knew he was about to lose, so he stopped fighting and held up his hands.

title: The stolen flame
caption: “Let’s stop,” Varek said. Arthur believed him.
notes: “Let’s stop. I don’t want to fight anymore,” Varek said. Arthur believed him and lowered his hands. Varek rushed forward, struck Arthur in the chest, and pulled out the flame. Arthur reached for it, but Varek had already moved away. Without his power, Arthur could no longer fly.

title: Arthur falls
caption: Arthur fell through the clouds and lost his memory.
notes: He fell through the clouds like a meteor and crashed onto the animals’ land. The ground shook, and branches broke around him. His body was still strong enough to survive, but he passed out. When he opened his eyes, he couldn’t remember anything, even his name.

title: Three animals help
caption: A lion, a bear, and a dog found Arthur.
notes: A lion found him beside a broken branch. A bear and a dog came over. “Is he alive?” the bear asked. The dog touched Arthur’s hand with his nose. His fingers moved. “Help me turn him over,” the dog said. They carried Arthur under the trees. He tried to stand, but his legs gave out.

title: A place to stay
caption: The bear built a shelter. The lion brought food. The dog stayed close.
notes: “Easy,” the bear said. “You’re staying here tonight.” One night turned into many. The bear built a shelter from branches and leaves. The lion brought food, even when it meant eating less himself. The dog slept beside Arthur and kept him warm. They had never seen anyone like him, but they helped anyway.

title: Living together
caption: Arthur got stronger and began helping his friends.
notes: Over the next few years, Arthur got stronger. He helped fix the shelter and carried food for his friends. Still, his memory never came back. One evening, the dog spotted a golden tree in the distance. The lion remembered a story about its fruit. It could bring back something someone had lost.

title: The journey to the tree
caption: They could only reach the tree by helping each other.
notes: The four friends set out the next morning. The lion found a path through the rocks. At a wide gap, the bear laid down a thick branch. Arthur held it while the others crossed. The dog followed the fruit’s sweet smell through the clouds. After three days, they finally reached the tree.

title: The golden fruit
caption: One bite brought Arthur’s memory and power back.
notes: The fruit looked like an apple covered in gold. Arthur picked one and took a bite. Heat spread through his body. Suddenly, he remembered the fight, his home, and his son. Light shone from his hands as his power returned. Far away, the flame Varek had stolen grew smaller until it disappeared.

title: Arthur remembers
caption: Arthur could go home, but he wanted to help his friends first.
notes: “I know who I am,” Arthur whispered. He could finally go home. Then he noticed the cuts on the bear’s paws. All his friends looked tired. They had come this far just to help him. Arthur looked at the empty space around their land. “You need a bigger home,” he said.

title: The new Earth
caption: Arthur made land, rivers, and forests for the animals.
notes: He knelt and pressed his hands against the ground. The land spread out until no one could see its edges. Mountains rose, and water ran from his fingers into rivers and seas. Grass and trees grew around them. Then he lifted the sky higher, giving the trees room to grow. The animals finally had a safe home.

title: The first human
caption: Arthur sent his son to live with the animals.
notes: Arthur returned to the sky. Later, he brought his son down to Earth and gave him a human body without any magic. “How will I live here?” his son asked. “You’ll have to learn,” Arthur said. “They taught me.” His son became the first human, and the animals welcomed him.

title: Room for a friend
caption: The animals helped the first human. He helped them too.
notes: The lion showed him where to find food. The bear helped him build a shelter, and the dog stayed with him at night. One cold evening, he saw the dog shaking outside the doorway. He moved his bed over and called the dog inside. There was enough room for both of them.
